title.en: Intensive reading: The meaning of security

intro.en: A reading passage about security (al-amn), one of Allah's great blessings. It explains how security brings calm and happiness, and how religious teaching protects people and society.
intro.ur: Amn (security) par ek matn, jo Allah ki bari nematon mein se hai. Yeh batata hai ke amn kaise sukoon aur khushi laata hai aur deeni taaleem insanon aur muashre ki kaise hifazat karti hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الأَمْنِ، وَهُوَ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ نِعَمِ اللهِ. يُبَيِّنُ كَيْفَ يَجْلِبُ الأَمْنُ الطُّمَأْنينَةَ وَالسَّعادَةَ، وَكَيْفَ تَحْمي التَّعاليمُ الدّينِيَّةُ النّاسَ وَالمُجْتَمَعَ.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَجَلِّ ما يَتَمَنّاهُ الإِنْسانُ في حَياتِهِ أَنْ يَعيشَ آمِناً في وَطَنِهِ وَبَيْتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: min ajalli mā yatamannāhu l-ʾinsānu fī ḥaiyātihi an yaʿīsha ʾāminan fī waṭanihi wabaytih.
dialogue.en: Among the noblest things a person wishes for in his life is to live safe in his homeland and his home.
dialogue.ur: Insan apni zindagi mein jin cheezon ki tamanna karta hai un mein sab se azeem yeh hai ke woh apne watan aur ghar mein mehfooz rahe.

dialogue.ar: فَالأَمْنُ نِعْمَةٌ لا يَعْرِفُ قيمَتَها إِلّا مَنْ ذاقَ مَرارَةَ الخَوْفِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-l-ʾamnu niʿmatun lā yaʿrifu qīmatahā illā man dhāqa marārata l-khawf.
dialogue.en: Security is a blessing whose value is known only by one who has tasted the bitterness of fear.
dialogue.ur: Amn ek nemat hai jis ki qadr wohi jaanta hai jis ne khauf ki talkhi chakhi ho.

dialogue.ar: وَحينَ يَسودُ الأَمْنُ تَنْتَشِرُ الطُّمَأْنينَةُ في القُلوبِ، وَيَعُمُّ الاسْتِقْرارُ المُدُنَ وَالقُرى.
dialogue.tr: waḥīna yasūdu l-ʾamnu tantashiru ṭ-ṭumaʾnīnatu fī l-qulūb, wayaʿummu l-āstiqrāru l-muduna wa-l-qurā.
dialogue.en: When security prevails, calm spreads in hearts and stability covers cities and villages.
dialogue.ur: Jab amn qaim hota hai to dilon mein itminan phailta hai aur shehron aur gaon mein istiqrar aam hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَعْمَلُ النّاسُ وَيَتَعَلَّمونَ وَيُسافِرونَ دونَ قَلَقٍ، فَتَزْدادُ السَّعادَةُ.
dialogue.tr: wayaʿmalu n-nāsu wayataʿallamūna wayusāfirūna dūna qalaqin, fatazdādu s-saʿādatu.
dialogue.en: People work, learn and travel without worry, and happiness increases.
dialogue.ur: Log be-fikr ho kar kaam karte, seekhte aur safar karte hain, to khushi barhti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِلْإِنْسانِ حُرْمَةٌ عَظيمَةٌ، فَلا يَجوزُ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَقْتُلَ غَيْرَهُ ظُلْماً، وَيَنْتَظِرُ القاتِلَ عُقوبَةٌ شَديدَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: walilʾinsāni ḥurmatun ʿaẓīmatun, falā yajūzu liʾaḥadin an yaqtula ghayrahu ẓulman, wayantaẓiru l-qātila ʿuqūbatun shadīdatun.
dialogue.en: A human being has a great sanctity, so no one may kill another unjustly, and a severe punishment awaits the killer.
dialogue.ur: Insan ki bari hurmat hai, is liye kisi ko jaiz nahin ke kisi ko nahaq qatl kare, aur qatil ke liye sakht saza hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالنَّفْسُ الإِنْسانِيَّةُ قَدْ تَميلُ إِلى الخَيْرِ، وَقَدْ يَغْلِبُها الشَّرُّ إِذا لَمْ تُهَذَّبْ.
dialogue.tr: wa-n-nafsu l-ʾinsāniyyatu qad tamīlu ilā l-khayr, waqad yaghlibuhā sh-sharru idhā lam tuhadhdhab.
dialogue.en: The human soul may incline to good, and evil may overcome it if it is not refined.
dialogue.ur: Insani nafs kabhi bhalai ki taraf maail hoti hai aur agar us ki tarbiyat na ho to burai us par ghalib aa sakti hai.

dialogue.ar: لِذَلِكَ جاءَتِ التَّعاليمُ الدّينِيَّةُ لِتُرَبِّيَ الفَرْدَ عَلى مُراقَبَةِ اللهِ وَاحْتِرامِ حُقوقِ الآخَرينَ.
dialogue.tr: lidhalika jāʾati t-taʿālīmu d-dīniyyatu liturabbiya l-farda ʿalā murāqabati Allāh wāḥtirāmi ḥuqūqi l-ʾākharīn.
dialogue.en: That is why religious teachings came to raise the individual to be conscious of Allah and respect the rights of others.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye deeni taaleemat aayin taake fard ki tarbiyat Allah ke muraqabe aur doosron ke huqooq ke ehtiram par ho.

dialogue.ar: وَجَعَلَتْ لِكُلِّ اعْتِداءٍ يُهَدِّدُ الجَماعَةَ عُقوبَةً تَمْنَعُ تَكْرارَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wajaʿalat likulli ʿtidāʾin yuhaddidu l-jamāʿata ʿuqūbatan tamnaʿu takrārah.
dialogue.en: And they set for every attack that threatens the community a punishment that prevents its repetition.
dialogue.ur: Aur har aise hamle ke liye jo jamaat ko khatre mein daale ek saza muqarrar ki jo us ke dohrane ko roke.

dialogue.ar: فَما أَجْمَلَ مُجْتَمَعاً يَحْمي فيهِ الفَرْدُ الجَماعَةَ، وَتَحْمي فيهِ الجَماعَةُ الفَرْدَ!
dialogue.tr: famā ajmala mujtamaʿan yaḥmī fīhi l-fardu l-jamāʿata, wataḥmī fīhi l-jamāʿatu l-fard!
dialogue.en: How beautiful is a society in which the individual protects the community and the community protects the individual!
dialogue.ur: Kitna khoobsurat hai woh muashira jahan fard jamaat ki hifazat karta hai aur jamaat fard ki!

q.en: According to the passage, what is security?
q.ur: Passage ke mutabiq amn kya hai?

q.en: What is the cause of happiness and stability?
q.ur: Khushi aur istiqraar ka sabab kya hai?

q.en: What does the human soul incline toward?
q.ur: Insani nafs kis ki taraf mayl karta hai?
q.ar: إِلى أَيِّ شَيْءٍ تَميلُ النَّفْسُ الإِنْسانِيَّةُ؟

options_ar: لا إِلى هذا وَلا إِلى ذاكَ

q.en: What did the Creator set for every act that harms security?
q.ur: Amn bigaadne wale har amal ke liye Khaliq ne kya muqarrar kiya?
q.ar: ماذا وَضَعَ الخالِقُ لِكُلِّ فِعْلٍ يُخِلُّ بِالأَمْنِ؟

title.ar: القَواعِدُ (أ): الجُمَلُ التي لَها مَحَلٌّ مِنَ الإِعْراب
title.en: Grammar A: Sentences that have a grammatical position
title.ur: Qawaid (alif): Wo jumle jin ka i'rab mein maqam hota hai

intro.en: Sometimes a whole sentence works like a single word. For example, in 'I greeted a student whose father is a doctor', the sentence 'his father is a doctor' describes the student, so it is a description (sifa). Here we practise sentences that act as a description (sifa) or as a state (hal).
intro.ur: Kabhi poora jumla ek lafz ki tarah kaam karta hai. Misal: 'maine ek aise talib-e-ilm ko salam kiya jis ke walid doctor hain' — yahan 'jis ke walid doctor hain' talib-e-ilm ki sifat bayan karta hai. Is sabaq mein hum sifa aur haal wale jumle seekhenge.
intro.ar: أَحْياناً تَقومُ جُمْلَةٌ كامِلَةٌ مَقامَ كَلِمَةٍ واحِدَةٍ، مِثْلَ: سَلَّمْتُ عَلى طالِبٍ والِدُهُ طَبيبٌ؛ فَجُمْلَةُ «والِدُهُ طَبيبٌ» تَصِفُ الطّالِبَ، فَهِيَ في مَحَلِّ صِفَةٍ. نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى الجُمَلِ الَّتي تَكونُ صِفَةً أَوْ حالاً.

dialogue.ar: الفَتاةُ أَدَبُها رَفيعٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-fatātu adabuhā rafīʿun.
dialogue.en: The girl, her manners are refined.
dialogue.ur: Ladki, us ka adab buland hai.

dialogue.ar: سَلَّمْتُ عَلى طالِبٍ والِدُهُ طَبيبٌ.
dialogue.tr: sallamtu ʿalā ṭālibin wa-d-duhu ṭabībun.
dialogue.en: I greeted a student whose father is a doctor.
dialogue.ur: Maine ek aise talib-e-ilm ko salam kiya jis ke walid doctor hain.

dialogue.ar: جاءَ الضَّيْفُ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ.
dialogue.tr: jāʾa ḍ-ḍayfu wahuwa yaḍḥak.
dialogue.en: The guest came laughing.
dialogue.ur: Mehmaan hanste hue aaya.

dialogue.ar: رَأَيْتُ الوَلَدَ يَلْعَبُ في الحَديقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: raʾaytu l-walada yalʿabu fī l-ḥadīqati.
dialogue.en: I saw the boy playing in the garden.
dialogue.ur: Maine bachche ko bagh mein khelte hue dekha.

q.en: After an indefinite noun, a sentence works as what?
q.ur: Nakira ke baad aane wala jumla kya hota hai?
q.ar: الجُمْلَةُ بَعْدَ اسْمٍ نَكِرَةٍ تَكونُ في مَحَلِّ:

q.en: After a definite noun, a sentence usually works as what?
q.ur: Ma'rifa ke baad aane wala jumla aam tor par kya hota hai?
q.ar: الجُمْلَةُ بَعْدَ اسْمٍ مَعْرِفَةٍ تَكونُ غالِباً في مَحَلِّ:

q.en: In 'I greeted a student whose father is a doctor', what does 'whose father is a doctor' do?
q.ur: «سَلَّمْتُ عَلى طالِبٍ والِدُهُ طَبيبٌ» mein «والِدُهُ طَبيبٌ» kya kaam karta hai?
q.ar: في «سَلَّمْتُ عَلى طالِبٍ والِدُهُ طَبيبٌ» ماذا تَفْعَلُ جُمْلَةُ «والِدُهُ طَبيبٌ»؟

q.en: What does 'مَحَلٌّ مِنَ الإِعْراب' mean?
q.ur: 'مَحَلٌّ مِنَ الإِعْراب' ka kya matlab hai?

title.ar: فَهْمُ المَسْموع: هَلْ أَسْئِلَةُ طِفْلِكَ تُقْلِقُك؟
title.en: Listening: Do your child's questions worry you?
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Kya aap ke bachche ke sawalat aap ko pareshan karte hain?

intro.en: Two listening parts about children's questions. Listen, then mark each sentence true or false. Children ask many questions because they are curious; parents should answer wisely, and ignoring questions has bad effects.
intro.ur: Yeh bachchon ke sawalat ke baare mein do sunne ke hisse hain. Sun kar har jumle ko sahih ya ghalat batana hai. Bachche isliye sawal poochte hain ke woh jaanna chahte hain; walidain ko samajhdari se jawab dena chahiye.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الطِّفْلِ. اسْتَمِعْ ثُمَّ احْكُمْ عَلى كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ. يَسْأَلُ الأَطْفالُ كَثيراً لِأَنَّهُمْ فُضولِيُّونَ، وَعَلى الوالِدَيْنِ أَنْ يُجيبا بِحِكْمَةٍ، وَتَجاهُلُ الأَسْئِلَةِ لَهُ آثارٌ سَيِّئَةٌ.

q.en: Using questions helps develop what in a child?
q.ur: Sawal karna bachche mein kya barhata hai?

q.en: What do children's questions reveal?
q.ur: Bachchon ke sawal kis cheez ko zahir karte hain?

q.en: How does a child feel if his questions are ignored?
q.ur: Agar sawalon ko nazar-andaz kiya jaye to bachcha kya mehsoos karta hai?
q.ar: بِماذا يَشْعُرُ الطِّفْلُ إِذا أُهْمِلَتْ أَسْئِلَتُهُ؟

q.en: A child asking many questions is a sign of what?
q.ur: Bachche ka bohat sawal karna kis ki nishani hai?

title.ur: Behtar izhaar: Sher parhna aur sunana

intro.en: How to recite poetry well: reading aloud with melody and clear pronunciation. A good delivery depends on correct language, good pronunciation, and expressing feelings such as joy or sadness. Then read a poem by Hafiz Ibrahim about the Arabic language.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein seekhenge ke sher kaise achhe se parha jata hai: buland awaaz, sahih alfaaz aur jazbaat ke saath. Phir Hafiz Ibrahim ka Arabi zuban ke baare mein qaseeda parhenge.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى إِنْشادِ الشِّعْرِ: القِراءَةُ بِصَوْتٍ عالٍ مَعَ نَغَمٍ وَنُطْقٍ واضِحٍ. يَعْتَمِدُ الإِلْقاءُ الجَيِّدُ عَلى سَلامَةِ اللُّغَةِ وَحُسْنِ النُّطْقِ وَالتَّعْبيرِ عَنِ المَشاعِرِ كَالفَرَحِ وَالحُزْنِ. ثُمَّ نَقْرَأُ قَصيدَةً لِحافِظ إِبْراهيمَ عَنِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ.

q.en: What does a good recitation of poetry include?
q.ur: Achhe sher parhne mein kya shamil hota hai?

q.en: Poetry is recited with what kind of voice?
q.ur: Sher kis qism ki awaaz mein parha jata hai?

q.en: Which feelings should the reciter express?
q.ur: Sher parhne wala kin jazbaat ka izhaar kare?
q.ar: أَيَّ المَشاعِرِ يَنْبَغي أَنْ يُظْهِرَ المُنْشِدُ؟

options: Joy, sadness and wonder as the meaning needs

q.en: The poem in the exercise is by whom?
q.ur: Mashq mein diya gaya qaseeda kis ka hai?

title.ar: القَواعِدُ (ب): الجُمَلُ التي لا مَحَلَّ لَها مِنَ الإِعْراب
title.en: Grammar B: Sentences with no grammatical position
title.ur: Qawaid (be): Wo jumle jin ka i'rab mein koi maqam nahin

intro.en: Some sentences do not take the place of a single word, so they have no grammatical position. Kinds include: opening sentences (ibtidaiyya), the clause after 'alladhi' (silat al-mawsul), interrupting sentences (mu'tarida), the answer of an oath, and the answer of a condition.
intro.ur: Kuch jumle kisi ek lafz ki jagah nahin lete, is liye un ka i'rab mein koi maqam nahin hota. Inki qismein: ibtidaiyya (shuru ka jumla), silat al-mawsul ('alladhi' ke baad ka jumla), mu'tarida (darmiyan mein aane wala), qasam ka jawab, aur shart ka jawab.
intro.ar: بَعْضُ الجُمَلِ لا تَحُلُّ مَحَلَّ كَلِمَةٍ واحِدَةٍ، فَلا مَحَلَّ لَها مِنَ الإِعْرابِ. مِنْ أَنْواعِها: الجُمْلَةُ الِابْتِدائِيَّةُ، وَصِلَةُ المَوْصولِ بَعْدَ «الَّذي»، وَالجُمْلَةُ الِاعْتِراضِيَّةُ، وَجَوابُ القَسَمِ، وَجَوابُ الشَّرْطِ.

dialogue.ar: الَّذي يُعينُ جارَهُ في الشِّدَّةِ يَنالُ مَحَبَّةَ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: alladhī yuʿīnu jārahu fī sh-shiddati yanālu maḥabbata n-nās.
dialogue.en: Whoever helps his neighbour in hardship gains people's love.
dialogue.ur: Jo apne padosi ki mushkil mein madad karta hai woh logon ki mohabbat paata hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنْ تَصْدُقْ تَنْجُ يا صَديقي.
dialogue.tr: in taṣduq tanju yā ṣadīqī.
dialogue.en: If you are truthful, you will be safe, my friend.
dialogue.ur: Agar tum sach bologe to bach jaoge mere dost.

dialogue.ar: المُعَلِّمُ – حَفِظَهُ اللهُ – يُحِبُّ طُلّابَهُ.
dialogue.tr: al-muʿallimu ḥafiẓahu Allāh yuḥibbu ṭullābah.
dialogue.en: The teacher, may Allah protect him, loves his students.
dialogue.ur: Ustaad, Allah un ki hifazat kare, apne shagirdon se mohabbat karte hain.

q.en: What does 'ibtidaiyya' mean?
q.ur: 'Ibtidaiyya' ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: The relative clause after 'alladhi' has what position?
q.ur: 'Alladhi' ke baad ke jumle ka kya maqam hai?
q.ar: ما مَوْقِعُ صِلَةِ المَوْصولِ بَعْدَ «الَّذي» مِنَ الإِعْرابِ؟

q.en: In 'If you are truthful, you will be safe', what is 'you will be safe'?
q.ur: «إِنْ تَصْدُقْ تَنْجُ» mein «تَنْجُ» ka i'rab kya hai?
q.ar: في «إِنْ تَصْدُقْ تَنْجُ» ما إِعْرابُ جُمْلَةِ «تَنْجُ»؟

q.en: What is a 'mu'tarida' sentence?
q.ur: 'Mu'tarida' jumla kya hota hai?

options: A sentence that interrupts in the middle

intro.en: A family story. Hala invites her family for dessert and says a prize of a million dinars has come to her. Each person speaks about what they would do with it. In the end it is only a joke, and Hala learns something about her family. After reading, answer the questions.
intro.ur: Ek khandani kahani. Hala apne ghar walon ko meethe par bulati hai aur kehti hai ke use ek million dinar ka inaam mila hai. Har ek batata hai ke woh us ka kya karega. Aakhir mein pata chalta hai ke yeh sirf mazaq tha, aur Hala apne khandan ke bare mein kuch seekhti hai. Parh kar sawalat ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ عائِلِيَّةٌ: تَدْعو هالَةُ أَهْلَها إِلى الحَلْوى وَتَقولُ إِنَّ جائِزَةً بِمِلْيونِ دينارٍ وَصَلَتْها. يَتَحَدَّثُ كُلُّ واحِدٍ عَمّا سَيَفْعَلُ بِها. وَفي النِّهايَةِ يَتَبَيَّنُ أَنَّها مُزْحَةٌ، وَتَتَعَلَّمُ هالَةُ شَيْئاً عَنْ أَهْلِها. بَعْدَ القِراءَةِ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

dialogue.ar: اجْتَمَعَتِ العائِلَةُ مَساءَ الخَميسِ في بَيْتِ الجَدِّ، وَكانَتْ رائِحَةُ الكُنافَةِ تَمْلَأُ المَكانَ.
dialogue.tr: jtamaʿati l-ʿāʾilatu masāʾa l-khamīsi fī bayti l-jaddi, wa kānat rāʾiḥatu l-kunāfati tamlaʾu l-makān.
dialogue.en: The family gathered on Thursday evening in grandfather's house, and the smell of kunafa filled the place.
dialogue.ur: Khandan jumeraat ki shaam dada ke ghar jama hua aur kunafa ki khushboo poori jagah par chhayi hui thi.

dialogue.ar: اجْلِسوا جَميعاً، فَعِنْدي مُفاجَأَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ لَكُمْ هَذا المَساءَ!
dialogue.tr: jlisū jamīʿan, faʿindī mufājaʾatun kabīratun lakum hādhā l-masāʾ!
dialogue.en: Everyone sit down, I have a big surprise for you this evening!
dialogue.ur: Sab baith jayen, aaj shaam mere paas aap sab ke liye ek bara surprise hai!

dialogue.ar: أَخيراً! أَنا مُتَشَوِّقٌ مُنْذُ الصَّباحِ؛ ما هِيَ؟
dialogue.tr: akhīran! anā mutashawwiqun mundhu ṣ-ṣabāḥ; mā hiy?
dialogue.en: At last! I have been eager since morning; what is it?
dialogue.ur: Aakhir! Main subah se betaab hoon; woh kya hai?

dialogue.ar: كُنْتُ مَشْغولَةً أُسْبوعَيْنِ بِحَلِّ أَلْغازِ مُسابَقَةٍ إِذاعِيَّةٍ، وَوَصَلَتْني رِسالَةٌ تَقولُ إِنَّني الفائِزَةُ بِجائِزَةٍ قَدْرُها مِلْيونُ دينارٍ.
dialogue.tr: kuntu mashghūlatan usbūʿayni biḥalli alghāzi musābaqatin idhāʿiyyatin, wawaṣalatnī risālatun taqūlu innanī l-fāʾizatu bijāʾizatin qadruhā milīūnu dīnārin.
dialogue.en: I was busy for two weeks solving the puzzles of a radio contest, and a message reached me saying I am the winner of a prize of one million dinars.
dialogue.ur: Main do hafte radio muqable ki paheliyan hal karne mein masroof thi, aur mujhe paigham mila ke main ek million dinar ke inaam ki fatih hoon.

dialogue.ar: غَيْرُ مَعْقولٍ! أَتَقولينَ الحَقيقَةَ يا ابْنَتي؟
dialogue.tr: ghayru maʿqūlin! ataqūlīna l-ḥaqīqata yā bnatī?
dialogue.en: Unbelievable! Are you telling the truth, my daughter?
dialogue.ur: Yaqeen nahin aata! Kya tum sach keh rahi ho meri beti?

dialogue.ar: لَوْ كانَ الخَبَرُ صَحيحاً لَاشْتَرَيْتُ سَيّارَةً لِلْعائِلَةِ كُلِّها!
dialogue.tr: law kāna l-khabaru ṣaḥīḥan lāshtaraytu sayyāratan lilʿāʾilati kullihā!
dialogue.en: If the news were true I would buy a car for the whole family!
dialogue.ur: Agar khabar sach hoti to main poore khandan ke liye gaari kharidta!

dialogue.ar: قَبْلَ أَنْ تُقَرِّروا شَيْئاً، أُريدُ مِنْكُمْ صِدْقاً وَصَراحَةً: كَيْفَ نَقْتَسِمُ المَبْلَغَ؟
dialogue.tr: qabla an tuqarrirū shayʾan, urīdu minkum ṣidqan waṣarāḥatan: kayfa naqtasimu l-mablagh?
dialogue.en: Before you decide anything, I want honesty and frankness from you: how shall we divide the amount?
dialogue.ur: Kuch tay karne se pehle main aap se sachchai aur saaf goi chahti hoon: hum raqam kaise baantein?

dialogue.ar: بِالتَّساوي طَبْعاً! لَكِنَّني أَكْبَرُ مِنْكُما، فَأَسْتَحِقُّ أَكْثَرَ قَليلاً!
dialogue.tr: bi-t-tasāwī ṭabʿan! lākinnanī akbaru minkumā, faʾastaḥiqqu akthara qalīlan!
dialogue.en: Equally, of course! But I am older than you two, so I deserve a little more!
dialogue.ur: Barabar barabar, zaahir hai! Magar main aap dono se bara hoon, is liye mera hissa zara zyada hona chahiye!

dialogue.ar: أَنا لا أُريدُ شَيْئاً يا بُنَيَّ، يَكْفيني أَنْ أَراكُمْ مُجْتَمِعينَ حَوْلي.
dialogue.tr: anā lā urīdu shayʾan yā bunayya, yakfīnī an arākum mujtamiʿīna ḥawlī.
dialogue.en: I want nothing, my son; it is enough for me to see you gathered around me.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe kuch nahin chahiye beta, mere liye itna kaafi hai ke aap sab mere gird jama hain.

dialogue.ar: لا تَقْلَقوا، سِرُّكُمْ عِنْدي، وَلَنْ يَعْرِفَ بِهِ أَحَدٌ. أَتُريدونَ الحَقيقَةَ الآنَ؟
dialogue.tr: lā taqlaqū, sirrukum ʿindī, walan yaʿrifa bihi aḥadun. aturīdūna l-ḥaqīqata l-ʾān?
dialogue.en: Do not worry, your secret is with me and no one will know it. Do you want the truth now?
dialogue.ur: Fikr na karein, aap ka raaz mere paas mehfooz hai, koi nahin jaanega. Kya ab aap haqeeqat jaanna chahte hain?

dialogue.ar: كانَتِ الرِّسالَةُ مُزاحاً مِنْ صَديقَتي، وَكُنْتُ مُتْعَبَةً وَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَعْرِفَ ما في قُلوبِكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: kānati r-risālatu muzāḥan min ṣadīqatī, wakuntu mutʿabatan waʾaradtu an aʿrifa mā fī qulūbikum.
dialogue.en: The message was a joke from my friend, and I was tired and wanted to know what is in your hearts.
dialogue.ur: Woh paigham meri saheli ka mazaq tha, main thaki hui thi aur chahti thi ke jaan loon aap ke dilon mein kya hai.

dialogue.ar: يا اللهُ! كِدْتُ أَذْهَبُ إِلى المَعْرِضِ لِأَشْتَرِيَ السَّيّارَةَ فِعْلاً!
dialogue.tr: yā Allā! kidtu adhhabu ilā l-maʿriḍi liʾashtariya s-sayyārata fiʿlan!
dialogue.en: Goodness! I almost went to the showroom to really buy the car!
dialogue.ur: Ya Allah! Main to sach much gaari kharidne showroom jaane hi wala tha!

dialogue.ar: وَالمُفاجَأَةُ الحَقيقِيَّةُ هِيَ هَذِهِ الحَلْوى الَّتي صَنَعْتُها بِيَدي لِنَأْكُلَها جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: wa-l-mufājaʾatu l-ḥaqīqiyyatu hiya hādhihi l-ḥalwā allatī ṣanaʿtuhā biyadī linaʾkulahā jamīʿan.
dialogue.en: And the real surprise is this sweet dish that I made with my own hands for all of us to eat.
dialogue.ur: Aur asli surprise yeh meetha hai jo maine apne haathon se banaya taake hum sab milkar khayen.

dialogue.ar: وَالمِلْيونُ الحَقيقِيُّ يا بُنَيَّتي هُوَ أَنْ نَبْقى مَعاً.
dialogue.tr: wa-l-milīūnu l-ḥaqīqiyyu yā bunayyatī huwa an nabqā maʿan.
dialogue.en: And the real million, my daughter, is that we stay together.
dialogue.ur: Aur asli million to yeh hai meri beti ke hum saath rahein.

intro.en: Words and expressions from the story, with exercises: fill in the verbs, put in words from the root ج-م-ع (j-m-ʿ) such as جَمْع (gathering) and جامِعَة (university), and understand idioms.
intro.ur: Kahani ke alfaaz aur muhawarat, mashqon ke saath: khaali jagah par sahih fe'l likhna, aur jeem-meem-ayn (ج-م-ع) ke maadde se bane alfaaz jaise جَمْع aur جامِعَة, aur muhawarat ko samajhna.
intro.ar: كَلِماتٌ وَتَعْبيراتٌ مِنَ القِصَّةِ مَعَ تَمارينَ: نَمْلَأُ الفَراغاتِ بِأَفْعالٍ، وَنَسْتَعْمِلُ كَلِماتٍ مِنَ الجَذْرِ (ج م ع) مِثْلَ جَمْعٌ وَجامِعَةٌ، وَنَفْهَمُ تَعْبيراتٍ اصْطِلاحِيَّةً.
